_description: Historical biotech strategic-process case library. Each case = one observable process signal event on one ticker. Same ticker may have multiple cases across time.

case_id.description: Unique case identifier. NNN = sequential per ticker per year.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol at time of signal.

observation_date.description: Date the process signal FIRST appeared in a public SEC filing. NOT the deal announcement date. NOT the research date. This is the t=0 for all relative price fields. See labeling rules.

signal_type.description: Primary signal that triggered this case entry. Reflects what a scanner would detect on observation_date.

event_type.description: Outcome classification. Labeled after resolution. ONGOING if unresolved.

process_state_at_signal.description: Process state the scanner would assign on observation_date.

sequence_type.description: Compound sequence pattern present at or before observation_date. SINGLE_SIGNAL if no multi-event pattern. Must be derived from actual filing history, not outcome.

item4_intent.description: Item 4 intent classification from SC 13D. NOT_APPLICABLE for non-13D signals. Must come from actual filing text, not inferred from outcome.

signal_quality.description: signal_quality field value the scanner would assign on observation_date.

mcap_at_signal_M.description: Market cap in USD millions on observation_date.

in_target_range.description: True if mcap_at_signal_M is between 150 and 1500 (scanner target universe).

analyst_coverage_count.description: Number of sell-side analyst ratings/coverage on observation_date. 0 = uncovered. VERIFY_REQUIRED if unknown.

price_30d_after.description: Stock closing price 30 calendar days after observation_date. Record as-traded. Do not adjust for acquisition price.

price_90d_after.description: Stock closing price 90 calendar days after observation_date.

price_180d_after.description: Stock closing price 180 calendar days after observation_date.

deal_announced.description: True if an acquisition/merger was announced after observation_date.

deal_date.description: Date of deal announcement 8-K filing. Null if no deal.

days_signal_to_deal.description: Calendar days from observation_date to deal_date. Null if no deal.

deal_type.description: Type of transaction. NONE for false positives.

deal_premium_pct.description: Premium to 30-day pre-announcement average price. NOT to price_at_signal unless deal announced within 30 days. Null if no deal or unverified.

deal_value_M.description: Total deal value in USD millions (equity value, not EV). Null if no deal.

deal_price_per_share.description: Per-share consideration in USD. Null if no deal or non-cash consideration.

acquirer.description: Acquirer company name. Null if no deal.

days_signal_to_outcome.description: Calendar days from observation_date to final outcome resolution. Null if ONGOING.

failure_reason.description: For non-deal outcomes: what observable factor drove the failure. Must be grounded in contemporaneous evidence, not hindsight. Max 300 chars.

rofr_scope.description: For ROFR/ROFN cases: scope of the rights. Whole-company ROFR is structurally different from program-level ROFR. Critical for false-positive suppression calibration.

source_filing_type.description: SEC form type (8-K, SC 13D, SC 13D/A, DEF 14A, 10-K, etc.).

source_filing_date.description: Date the triggering filing was submitted to SEC EDGAR. Often same as observation_date.

source_filing_url.description: Direct URL to the triggering filing on SEC EDGAR. Must be EDGAR link, not press release.

excerpt_text.description: Key excerpt from the triggering filing text (max 300 chars). The exact language that triggered signal classification.

hotspot_area.description: Therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, neurology, cardiology, rare disease, etc.).

notes.description: Free-text annotations. Flag anything unusual, ambiguous, or requiring follow-up.

data_quality.description: VERIFIED = all fields confirmed against primary sources. PARTIAL = some fields confirmed, some approximate. VERIFY_REQUIRED = structural placeholder only.

added_date.description: Date this case was added to the library.
